button.add-hovered-card: Add the card under the pointer

description.access-ends-link: The current link stops working for good.
description.access-private-people: Only you and the people above.
description.access-public: On your public profile, findable by anyone.
description.access-unlisted: No account needed. Not on your profile.
description.bug-report-crop: The cut-out of the card the scanner last tried to read goes along as an image. Never the whole camera picture.
description.bug-report-images: Up to three images, screenshots for example. They are shrunk before sending and sent without location data.
description.bug-report-text: What did you want to do, and what happened instead?
description.bug-report-thanks: Your bug report has the number #{{number}}. Mention it when you write to us about it.
description.delete-session: “{{name}}” and everything still staged in it will be deleted. Cards already filed stay in their collection.
description.report-bug: Describe what didn't work. What the app noticed goes along, so we can find the bug.
description.username: Shown publicly. 3 to 32 characters; letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and dot are allowed, and the first character has to be a letter or a digit.
description.wizard-invalid: The assistant "{{wizard}}" is broken and can't be shown. Please report it to us.

error.bug-report-failed: Sending didn't work. Your text stays here, try again in a moment.
error.bug-report-image-invalid: One of the images could not be read.
error.bug-report-image-too-large: An image is larger than 5 MB.
error.bug-report-rate-limited: You sent 15 bug reports in the last hour already. Please try again later.
error.bug-report-text-missing: Please write a few words about what happened.
error.bug-report-text-too-long: The text can be at most 5000 characters long.
error.index-not-ready: The reference index is not ready yet.
error.provider-unavailable: That login is not reachable right now. Try again later.
error.username-charset: Only letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and dot are allowed.
error.username-length: The username has to be 3 to 32 characters long.
error.username-start: The first character has to be a letter or a digit.
error.username-taken: That username is already taken. Pick a different one.
error.invalid-entry-fee: Enter an amount above zero, e.g. 5 or 5.50.

label.bug-report-recognitions_one: The scanner's last recognition: the name it read and its candidates
label.bug-report-recognitions_other: The scanner's last {{count}} recognitions: the names it read and their candidates
label.bug-report-requests_one: {{count}} recent request to the server, without contents
label.bug-report-requests_other: {{count}} recent requests to the server, without contents
label.price-from-english: Market price of the English printing. Cardmarket sells every language as one product, so there is no price per language.
label.version-warning: Early version {{version}} – bugs and data loss are still possible.

toast.session-expired: Session expired, please sign in again
toast.share-link-copy-failed: The link could not be copied.
